meta.datasetName: TDC Matchmaker Dashboard — Fictional MVP Seed Data
meta.generatedFor: Local development and matching workflow testing only
notes: All names and records are synthetic. Emails use example.test and phone numbers are reserved dummy values.
This dataset contains exactly 110 customers, balanced as 55 MAN and 55 WOMAN, assigned across six demo matchmakers.
Employment, designation, company, industry, and income fields were reviewed for consistency; optional cultural fields are not fabricated as specific communities.
Frontend demo credentials are not stored in this dataset; configure them as a frontend-only constant.
No profile photos are included. Sensitive cultural fields are optional and must not be scored unless the person explicitly records a preference.
Scores on retained match records are illustrative workflow fixtures; recalculate through the matching engine before relying on them.
